newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian insurers must focus on customers - conference.
newsitem.headline: Asian insurers must focus on customers - conference.

text.p: Insurance companies in Asia must train their staff to understand the needs of customers if they want to be profitable, an industry conference was told on Tuesday.

The importance of high quality customer service was spelled out to delegates at the East Asian Insurance Congress conference in Singapore by Dan L Ting, general manager of the Taiwan branch of the Life Insurance Company of Georgia.
"The message is clear. We must accelerate our employee development and retention program. We must get all of our employees concentrating on the critical needs of the customer," he said.
Tan stressed the importance of identifying the internal and external customers of every person in the company, and of understanding those needs and desires for products and services.
Next, he said, they must deliver those products or services in a way which exceeds the customer's expectation.

"We cannot afford to lose customers just because finding and building new customer relationships is a very expensive process and because the customers we have are likely to be the most profitable we will ever have," said Tan.

"As the world continues to change, and change becomes more rapid, our competitors continue to improve their operations, and we must continue to deliver continuous improvement in everything we do," said Tan.
